info.title: planninq demo data
info.description: Example data for planninq: three projects with their boards, phases, tasks, dependencies, logged time, risks, status reports, finance lines and portfolios, plus a few timetable sessions. Every person in it is the admin who loads it, and every date is placed around the day it is loaded.

x-openregister.description: Demo data for planninq. NOT installed automatically — a mock register is imported on demand, from the setup walkthrough or `occ openregister:descriptors:list --app=planninq --import=<slug>`.
